 Advertisement Updated: 2:02 PM EDT Oct 30, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jennifer Osting Early voting in Kentucky and Indiana | Where you can vote and when
 Updated: 2:02 PM EDT Oct 30, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jennifer Osting LOUISVILLE, Ky. — Early voting is underway in Kentucky and Indiana, but voters living on either side of the Ohio River have different deadlines. 
 If you're planning to cast your ballot before Election Day, here's a breakdown of when early voting ends in Kentucky and Indiana. 
 Advertisement Kentucky 
 Before Election Day, voters in the commonwealth have until 6 p.m. Saturday, October 31 to cast their ballots without needing an excuse. 
 There is at least one early voting location in each of Kentucky's 120 counties.

 Indiana 
 Hoosiers have a longer window than Kentucky voters. 
 Early voting in Indiana continues until noon Monday, November 2. 
 Indiana counties are also required to provide absentee voting on the two Saturdays before the election. 
 Here's a look at early voting hours across southern Indiana: 
 Clark County: 9 a.m. - 4 p.m. daily | Clark County Judicial Center 501E Court Ave #139 
 Floyd County: 8 a.m. - 4 p.m. Friday (Novaparke) , 9 a.m. - 3 p.m. Saturday, no voting Sunday and 8 a.m. - noon Monday (Novaparke or 4-H Fairgrounds)
 Harrison County: 9 a.m. - 4 p.m. Friday, 8 a.m. - 3 p.m. Saturday, no voting Sunday and 9 a.m. - noon Monday | Harrison County Government Center 
 Jackson County: 8 a.m. - 3 p.m. Friday and Saturday, as well as 8 a.m. - noon Monday. 
 Jefferson County: 9 a.m. - 4 p.m. Friday, 8 a.m. - 3 p.m. Saturday and 9 a.m. - noon Sunday | Jefferson County Courthouse Commissioner's office (1st floor) 
 Jennings County: 8 a.m. - 4 p.m. Friday and Saturday, as well as 8 a.m. - noon Monday. | Jennings County Courthouse 
 Scott County: 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday, as well as 8:30 a.m. - 12:30 p.m. Monday. | Scott County Courthouse (Clerk’s Office) and Austin High School
 Voters can find their early voting locations through the state's voter portal. 
 Election Day 
 If you miss the early voting deadlines, you can still vote on Election Day, which is Tuesday, November 3. 
 Both Kentucky and Indiana polling locations will be open from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. local time. 
 Anyone in line by 6 p.m. will be allowed to vote. 
 For more information on what voters need to know before heading to the polls, visit WLKY's election guide.
